export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for IBK ENGINEERS PRIVATE LIMITED (https://importkey.com/countries/india/ibk-engineers-private-limited) shows 1650 records, but the visible rows are all INBOUND to India, e.g. "2026-02-17 | SNPROUSA LLC | IBK ENGINEERS PRIVATE LIMITED | Phillips Bit 1/4 Hex Shank 2.75 - (MACHINERY PART) | NEW YORK, SINGAPORE -> BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India | 84879000 | BOL 7587399". Ports listed are TOKYO 106, BANGALORE ACC 81, BANGALORE ACC INBLR4 74, NEW YORK 36, TAIPEI 13 — i.e. import lanes. No outbound India->foreign bill of lading with date, destination and HS code was visible. Source counter: page header claims "Total Shipments 1650 Records detected"; rows actually rendered on the free view = 5 shipment rows (all imports) + 5 supplier rows + 2 buyer rows. Only indirect hint of outbound trade: a buyer-side row "M.N INTERNATIONAL ... IBK ENGINEERS PRIVATE LIMITED, THAPATHALI-11, PARWATI MARG HOUSE NO.233, KATHMANDU NEPAL" with 7 shipments, which suggests a small Nepal-bound lane, but no date, HS code or B/L number is shown, so it is not confirmed.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. thecompanycheck.com, volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403 to the fetch, and the DuckDuckGo search backend returned "Connection refused" on both queries, so no domestic-supply record was seen. Registered address visible on ImportKey: "#12 A ESHWAR TEMPLE ROAD, DODDAKALLASANDRA" (Bengaluru, Karnataka).
note: Declared HS 848590 does not match the observed trade HS: the visible customs rows carry HS 84879000 (machinery parts — bits, spring plungers, torque screwdrivers, O-rings, magnets) sourced from SNPROUSA LLC, NIHON PISCO and PISCO TAIWAN. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the factual code should be corrected to 84879000 (verdict accepted_hs_corrected). Role: trader/importer-distributor of machinery components rather than a manufacturer of HS 8485 machines — the goods are bought in from the USA, Japan and Taiwan and cleared at Bangalore ACC. On rule 5: real customs activity is confirmed, but it is import activity, not export. No export shipment with date, destination, HS code and B/L number was found, and no domestic supply evidence (GST band, GeM/CPPP, contract) could be retrieved because all registry/aggregator sources blocked the fetch and the search backend was down. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in what was accessible, not estimated. Do not read this as 'conditionally accepted': on the export side there are no traces of shipments found; on the domestic side the status is unknown rather than negative, purely because of source access failure, and should be re-checked when search is restored.
